name: Local AI writer
description: A free language model that runs on this computer and writes promo voice-overs and on-screen text naturally ("Coming up next, SpongeBob, followed by even more SpongeBob!"), even joking about the episode. No account or API costs. Or use a model from Ollama or LM Studio. Also transcribes episodes with Whisper, so promos can pick out their best moments.
author: SchedularrTV
lowPowerNotice: the built-in model runs on the processor only: roughly 10 to 40 seconds a piece with the 0.8B or 2B model. Avoid the 4B model on boards with less than 8 GB, or use a model served from a stronger computer.

settings.label: Processor threads
settings.description: How many processor threads the built-in model uses while writing. Leave empty to use half of them, so the rest of the computer stays responsive.
settings.lowPowerNote: Half (2 on a Pi) keeps the channels on air smooth; 3 writes faster if nothing is being encoded.

settings.label: Free memory after (minutes)
settings.description: The built-in model is let go of after this long without writing anything, and loaded again (a few seconds) when it's next needed.

settings.label: Your own model file
settings.description: Any instruction-tuned GGUF file, used when "Your own model file" is chosen below. Small (1 to 4 billion parameter) models are quick enough.

settings.label: Models folder
settings.description: Where downloaded models go. Leave empty for the plugin's own data folder.

settings.label: Episodes' language (speech recognition)
settings.description: The two-letter language the episodes speak (en, fr, es...), for the Whisper transcripts that AI-curated promo clips are picked from. Leave empty to have Whisper work it out.

settings.label: Your own Whisper model file
settings.description: A whisper.cpp ggml model (ggml-*.bin), used when "Your own Whisper model" is chosen below.

settings.label: Server type
settings.description: Optional: a model served by Ollama, or by anything with an OpenAI-style API (LM Studio, llama.cpp's server, LocalAI...). It shows up as a second writer, "Local AI server".

settings.label: Server address
settings.description: Leave empty for the usual address: http://localhost:11434 for Ollama, http://localhost:1234 for LM Studio.

settings.label: Server model
settings.description: The model's name on the server. The server writer stays off until one is named; use Find models below to pick one.

settings.label: Server API key
settings.description: Only if the server asks for one.
